figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure  1.	 Biosynthetic pathway leading to antraquinone glucosides. 
PSPG; plant secondary product glycosyltransferase.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure  2.	 Phylogenetic analysis of RpUGTs. The PSPG clones isolated 
in this investigation are shown in boldface. The tree was generated by 
the neighbor-joining method following multiple alignments by the 
ClustalW algorithm. The bar indicates a 0.1 amino acid substitution/
site. For the names and DDBJ/GenBank/EMBL accession numbers of 
other PSPGs, see Supplementary Table S4.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure  3.	 Glucosylation of emodin by RpUGT1. Emodin was incubated with RpUGT1 in the presence of UDP-glucose for 4 min (A) or 40 min (B), 
and the assay mixture was subjected to HPLC analysis. Reaction product was identified as emodin-6-O-glucoside by NMR and MS measurements. 
HPLC conditions are shown in Supplementary Methods.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption: Figure  4.	 Substrate specificity of recombinant RpUGT1. The compounds within the dotted frame were glucosylated by RpUGT1.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 5
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure  5.	 Glucosylation activity of RpUGT1. HPLC analysis of 
recombinant RpUGT1 incubated with rhapontigenin (A), daizein 
(B), genistein (C), apigenin (D), kaempferol (E), and quercetin (F). 
Rhapontigenin, genistein, kaempferol, and quercetin were incubated 
for 10 min. Daizein and apigenin were incubated for 180 min. HPLC 
conditions are shown in Supplementary Methods.

figure_candidates.caption: Table  1.  Relative activity of recombinant RpUGT1.

figure_candidates.label: Table 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Table  2.  Kinetic parameters of recombinant RpUGT1 for emodin,

figure_candidates.label: Figure 6
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure  6.  Tissue distribution of RpUGT1 mRNA and metabolites 
in Rheum palmatum. All organs were collected from an individual of 
Rheum palmatum on the same day, powdered in liquid nitrogen, and 
used for mRNA preparation and metabolite extraction. (A) qRT-PCR 
analysis of mRNA levels of RpUGT1. Contents of emodin and its 
glucosides (B), rhapontigenin and rhaponticin (C) contents in various 
organs. Each box and bar represent an average value and standard 
deviation, respectively, from triplicate measurements.
